messages:
maya: quick sync — proposing we lock the v3.2.1 cutoffs so teams can plan. suggested windows below, pls ack if your team can meet them.

maya: US cutoff: 2026-05-04 23:59 PT (tag + changelog done)
maya: EU cutoff: 2026-05-05 08:00 UTC (final docs + regressions)
maya: APAC cutoff: 2026-05-05 00:30 SGT (code + infra migrations finished)

tom: ack on the dates — can we get a hard branch freeze 30m after each cutoff? makes cherry-picks easier. :thumbsup:

eli: FYI staging canaries need 2 hours earlier for APAC to warm caches. can we start canary at 2026-05-05 22:30 SGT?

maya: good call. updated plan: canaries start 2h before APAC cutoff for warmup. will note in release checklist.

sophie: changelog PRs — can we put a label `release-v3.2.1` on final PRs? makes automation pick them up.

jen: PM note — please include list of user-facing fixes in the release notes draft (I can help edit) by cutoff.

tom: ops question — any DB migration? if yes we should reserve a 15m maintenance window post-deploy (low traffic).

maya: one lightweight migration: add column with backfill via background job (no lock). still schedule 15m buffer post-deploy.

deploy-bot: heads-up: automated canary job scheduled when tags are pushed. command to tag: `git tag -a v3.2.1 -m \"release v3.2.1\" && git push origin v3.2.1`

eli: will coordinate canary dashboards and slack alerts. can everyone add a quick smoke test to their PRs? 1-2 asserts enough.

maya: branching rules: cut release branch from `main` at US cutoff; do not merge feature branches after freeze unless exception approved by eng-release lead.

tom: noted. if we need emergency fix after freeze: cut `hotfix/v3.2.1.x` and coordinate with me for expedited review.

sophie: tagging checklist (put in PR): 1) changelog entry 2) smoke test 3) ops playbook link 4) migration note (if any).

maya: <@jen> can you confirm docs team will be on standby for EU morning edits?

jen: yes, I'll be available 07:30-10:30 UTC, will triage releases and small edits.

eli: small ops ask — PLEASE add timezone conversions in the release ticket. I keep missing DST weirdness. ;)

maya: agreed. I'll update the ticket with both UTC and local times for US/EU/APAC.

deploy-bot: reminder: after tagging the bot will run pre-flight checks: unit tests, lint, container build. any failing check blocks canary.

tom: can we add a short rollback playbook to the ticket? quick steps + who to ping.

maya: i'll add rollback steps and the pager rotation for the release window.

sophie: one last nit: update `CHANGELOG.md` template to include internal infra notes under a separate heading — helps ops.

maya: thanks everyone — if no objections i'll lock cutoffs and branch freeze at 1899998765 (this thread) by EOD today. please react :thumbsup: if you're good or reply with conflicts.

eli: :thumbsup:

tom: :thumbsup:

sophie: :thumbsup:

maya: locking now unless I hear blockers. will post final checklist & release-ticket link when done.
